title: SCA Tish'a BeAb 2022: The Aliyah Experience

chapters.title: Introduction to the Aliyah panel
chapters.about: Mo Sutton introduces the topic of Aliyah within the community.

chapters.title: Tish'a BeAb and the spies
chapters.about: The connection between Tish'a BeAb, Masekhet Taanit, and the story of the spies.

chapters.title: Panelist introductions
chapters.about: Participants share their names, family status, and when they made Aliyah.

chapters.title: Personal stories of moving to Israel
chapters.about: Adele Tawil and others discuss their motivations and experiences.

summary: Mo Sutton leads a panel of community members who share their personal experiences of making Aliyah to Eretz Yisrael. The discussion explores the challenges and joys of moving to Israel, including the social aspects of life there and the process of building a home in the land.
questions: Why is it important to talk about Aliyah on Tish'a BeAb?
Is it possible to make Aliyah as a single person?
What are the social challenges of moving to Israel?
How does the community view the decision to move to Israel?
